hook_stat.sub: Mail ballots the Justice Department wants set aside until citizenship is verified

news_summary: The Justice Department sued California on October 15 to block the counting of mail ballots from more than 20,000 voters the administration alleges are likely noncitizens, until their citizenship is verified.
payoff: A judge in Los Angeles must now decide whether to grant emergency relief, with voting already under way.
